description: Defines an immutable data class JLGClientData for clients with loans and savings due, including factory methods and accessors.

classes.name: JLGClientData
classes.description: Immutable data object for clients with loans due for disbursement or collection, with methods for creation and data access.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new JLGClientData instance with clientId, clientName, and attendanceType, with loans and savings initialized to null.

methods.name: withSavings
methods.description: Creates a new JLGClientData instance based on an existing client, adding savings data.

methods.name: withAttendance
methods.description: Creates a new JLGClientData instance with specified attendanceType, loans and savings set to null.

methods.name: getLoans
methods.description: Returns the collection of loan due data.

methods.name: setLoans
methods.description: Sets the collection of loan due data.

methods.name: getSavings
methods.description: Returns the collection of savings due data.

methods.name: setSavings
methods.description: Sets the collection of savings due data.
